+package trafficpolicy
+
+import (

+	"time"

+
+type consistentHashIR struct {
+	disable      bool
+	hashPolicies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	// defaultedSourceIp tracks whether the sourceIp hash policy was defaulted
+	// from an empty consistentHash: {} rather than explicitly specified.
+	// +noKrtEquals
+	defaultedSourceIp bool
+	// suppressed tracks whether a disable=true policy was encountered during merge,
+	// preventing any lower-priority policies from being unioned.
+	// +noKrtEquals
+	suppressed bool
+}
+
+var _ PolicySubIR = &consistentHashIR{}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Equals(other PolicySubIR) bool {
+	otherCH, ok := other.(*consistentHashIR)
+	if !ok {
+		return false
+	}
+	if c == nil || otherCH == nil {
+		return c == nil && otherCH == nil
+	}
+	if c.disable != otherCH.disable {
+		return false
+	}
+	return slices.EqualFunc(c.hashPolicies, otherCH.hashPolicies, func(a, b *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) bool {
+		return proto.Equal(a, b)
+	})
+}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Validate() error {
+	if c == nil || c.disable {
+		return nil
+	}
+	for _, hp := range c.hashPolicies {
+		if hp == nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		if header := hp.GetHeader(); header != nil {
+			if rr := header.GetRegexRewrite(); rr != nil && rr.GetPattern() != nil {
+				if err := regexutils.CheckRegexString(rr.GetPattern().GetRegex()); err != nil {
+					return fmt.Errorf("invalid regex pattern: %w", err)
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		if err := hp.ValidateAll(); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) clone() *consistentHashIR {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	var clonedPolicies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	if len(c.hashPolicies) > 0 {
+		clonedPolicies = make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy, len(c.hashPolicies))
+		for i, hp := range c.hashPolicies {
+			clonedPolicies[i] = proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy)
+		}
+	}
+	return &consistentHashIR{
+		disable:           c.disable,
+		hashPolicies:      clonedPolicies,
+		defaultedSourceIp: c.defaultedSourceIp,
+		suppressed:        c.suppressed,
+	}
+}
+
+func defaultSourceIpHashPolicy() *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy {
+	return &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+		PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+			ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+				SourceIp: true,
+			},
+		},

+	}
+}

+func parseCookieTTL(ttlStr string) (*durationpb.Duration, error) {
+	if d, err := time.ParseDuration(ttlStr); err == nil {
+		if d < 0 {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid cookie ttl %q: duration must be non-negative", ttlStr)
+		}
+		return durationpb.New(d), nil
+	}
+	if secs, err := strconv.ParseInt(ttlStr, 10, 64); err == nil {
+		if secs < 0 {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid cookie ttl %q: duration must be non-negative", ttlStr)
+		}
+		return durationpb.New(time.Duration(secs) * time.Second), nil
+	}
+	return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid cookie ttl %q: must be a Go duration or integer seconds", ttlStr)
+}

+func constructConsistentHash(spec kgateway.TrafficPolicySpec, out *trafficPolicySpecIr) error {
+	if spec.ConsistentHash == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	ch := spec.ConsistentHash
+	if ptr.Deref(ch.Disable, false) {
+		if len(ch.Headers) > 0 || len(ch.Cookies) > 0 || len(ch.QueryParameters) > 0 || len(ch.FilterState) > 0 || ch.SourceIp != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("consistentHash: when disable is true, no other fields may be set")
+		}
+		out.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{
+			disable:    true,
+			suppressed: true,
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	seenHeaders := sets.New[string]()
+	var headers []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	for _, h := range ch.Headers {
+		key := strings.ToLower(h.HeaderName)
+		if seenHeaders.Has(key) {
+			continue
+		}
+		seenHeaders.Insert(key)
+
+		headerSpec := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header{
+			HeaderName: h.HeaderName,
+		}
+		if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+			headerSpec.RegexRewrite = &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatchAndSubstitute{
+				Pattern: &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatcher{
+					Regex: h.RegexRewrite.Pattern,
+				},
+				Substitution: h.RegexRewrite.Substitution,
+			}
+		}
+		headers = append(headers, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_{
+				Header: headerSpec,
+			},
+			Terminal: ptr.Deref(h.Terminal, false),
+		})
+	}
+
+	seenCookies := sets.New[string]()
+	var cookies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	for _, c := range ch.Cookies {
+		if seenCookies.Has(c.Name) {
+			continue
+		}
+		seenCookies.Insert(c.Name)
+
+		cookieSpec := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie{
+			Name: c.Name,
+		}
+		if c.TTL != nil {
+			ttlDur, err := parseCookieTTL(*c.TTL)
+			if err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			cookieSpec.Ttl = ttlDur
+		}
+		if c.Path != nil {
+			cookieSpec.Path = *c.Path
+		}
+		if len(c.Attributes) > 0 {
+			attrs := make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute, 0, len(c.Attributes))
+			for _, attr := range c.Attributes {
+				attrs = append(attrs, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute{
+					Name:  attr.Name,
+					Value: attr.Value,
+				})
+			}
+			cookieSpec.Attributes = attrs
+		}
+		cookies = append(cookies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_{
+				Cookie: cookieSpec,
+			},
+			Terminal: ptr.Deref(c.Terminal, false),
+		})
+	}
+
+	seenQueryParams := sets.New[string]()
+	var queryParams []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	for _, q := range ch.QueryParameters {
+		if seenQueryParams.Has(q.Name) {
+			continue
+		}
+		seenQueryParams.Insert(q.Name)
+
+		queryParams = append(queryParams, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_{
+				QueryParameter: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter{
+					Name: q.Name,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: ptr.Deref(q.Terminal, false),
+		})
+	}
+
+	seenFilterStates := sets.New[string]()
+	var filterStates []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	for _, f := range ch.FilterState {
+		if seenFilterStates.Has(f.Key) {
+			continue
+		}
+		seenFilterStates.Insert(f.Key)
+
+		filterStates = append(filterStates, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_{
+				FilterState: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState{
+					Key: f.Key,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: ptr.Deref(f.Terminal, false),
+		})
+	}
+
+	var sourceIp *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	if ch.SourceIp != nil {
+		sourceIp = &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+				ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+					SourceIp: true,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: ptr.Deref(ch.SourceIp.Terminal, false),
+		}
+	}
+
+	hashPolicies := slices.Concat(headers, cookies, queryParams, filterStates)
+	if sourceIp != nil {
+		hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, sourceIp)
+	}
+
+	defaultedSourceIp := false
+	if len(hashPolicies) == 0 {
+		defaultedSourceIp = true
+		hashPolicies = []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			defaultSourceIpHashPolicy(),
+		}
+	}
+
+	out.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{
+		hashPolicies:      hashPolicies,
+		defaultedSourceIp: defaultedSourceIp,
+	}
+	return nil
+}

+// unionConsistentHash merges two non-disabled consistentHashIRs where high has higher priority than low.
+// Array fields are unioned with high's entries first, deduplicated by identifying key, and re-sorted
+// into canonical type order (headers, cookies, queryParameters, filterState, sourceIp).
+// The sourceIp scalar retains high's value even when unset.
+func unionConsistentHash(high, low *consistentHashIR) *consistentHashIR {
+	seenHeaders := sets.New[string]()
+	seenCookies := sets.New[string]()
+	seenQueryParams := sets.New[string]()
+	seenFilterStates := sets.New[string]()
+
+	var headers []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	var cookies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	var queryParams []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	var filterStates []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	var sourceIp *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+
+	appendFrom := func(ir *consistentHashIR, isHigh bool) {
+		if ir == nil {
+			return
+		}
+		for _, hp := range ir.hashPolicies {
+			if hp == nil {
+				continue
+			}
+			switch {
+			case hp.GetHeader() != nil:
+				key := strings.ToLower(hp.GetHeader().GetHeaderName())
+				if !seenHeaders.Has(key) {
+					seenHeaders.Insert(key)
+					headers = append(headers, proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy))
+				}
+			case hp.GetCookie() != nil:
+				key := hp.GetCookie().GetName()
+				if !seenCookies.Has(key) {
+					seenCookies.Insert(key)
+					cookies = append(cookies, proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy))
+				}
+			case hp.GetQueryParameter() != nil:
+				key := hp.GetQueryParameter().GetName()
+				if !seenQueryParams.Has(key) {
+					seenQueryParams.Insert(key)
+					queryParams = append(queryParams, proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy))
+				}
+			case hp.GetFilterState() != nil:
+				key := hp.GetFilterState().GetKey()
+				if !seenFilterStates.Has(key) {
+					seenFilterStates.Insert(key)
+					filterStates = append(filterStates, proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy))
+				}
+			case hp.GetConnectionProperties() != nil:
+				// Only retain sourceIp from the higher-priority policy if it was explicitly set
+				if isHigh && !ir.defaultedSourceIp && sourceIp == nil {
+					sourceIp = proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy)
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	appendFrom(high, true)
+	appendFrom(low, false)
+
+	hashPolicies := slices.Concat(headers, cookies, queryParams, filterStates)
+	if sourceIp != nil {
+		hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, sourceIp)
+	}
+
+	defaultedSourceIp := false
+	if len(hashPolicies) == 0 {
+		defaultedSourceIp = true
+		hashPolicies = []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			defaultSourceIpHashPolicy(),
+		}
+	}
+
+	return &consistentHashIR{
+		hashPolicies:      hashPolicies,
+		defaultedSourceIp: defaultedSourceIp,
+	}
+}
+
+func applyConsistentHash(consistentHash *consistentHashIR, out *envoyroutev3.Route) {
+	if consistentHash == nil || out == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	action := out.GetRoute()
+	if action == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	if consistentHash.disable {
+		action.HashPolicy = nil
+		return
+	}
+	action.HashPolicy = consistentHash.hashPolicies
+}

+func mergeConsistentHash(
+	p1, p2 *TrafficPolicy,
+	p2Ref *ir.AttachedPolicyRef,
+	p2MergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	opts policy.MergeOptions,
+	mergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	tpOpts TrafficPolicyMergeOpts,
+) {
+	if tpOpts.ConsistentHash != "" {
+		opts.Strategy = policy.ToInternalMergeStrategy(tpOpts.ConsistentHash)
+	}
+	if p2.spec.consistentHash == nil {
+		return
+	}
+
+	if p1.spec.consistentHash == nil {
+		if !policy.IsMergeable(p1.spec.consistentHash, p2.spec.consistentHash, opts) {
+			return
+		}
+		p1.spec.consistentHash = p2.spec.consistentHash.clone()
+		mergeOrigins.SetOne("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+		return
+	}
+
+	switch opts.Strategy {
+	case policy.AugmentedShallowMerge, policy.AugmentedDeepMerge:
+		// p1 is higher priority than p2

+		}
+		p1.spec.consistentHash = unionConsistentHash(p1.spec.consistentHash, p2.spec.consistentHash)
+		if p2.spec.consistentHash.suppressed {
+			p1.spec.consistentHash.suppressed = true
+		}
+		mergeOrigins.Append("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+
+	case policy.OverridableShallowMerge, policy.OverridableDeepMerge:
+		// p2 is higher priority than p1, except disable on narrower-scoped p1 suppresses inherited p2
